provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Karak: Sidhar, Kirima, Elspeth hero sheet (Albi, 2022)

steps.text: Starting dungeon tile in the middle of the table
Shuffle the other tiles facedown within everyone's reach
Monster and treasure tokens in the bag
Add the Regent tiles (arenas, cursed chambers, rooms), monster tokens and heroes to the base components
Each player takes an inventory sheet with {n} HP tokens on it
Add the Sidhar, Kirima and Elspeth hero cards and figures to the heroes to choose from
Each player picks a hero card (chosen or random) onto their sheet
Hero figures in their stands (stand color matches the card) on the starting tile
Game ends when someone defeats the dragon and loots its treasure; most treasure wins
Lord of Karak version: he enters play once 5 of his chambers are discovered, controlled by the player with the weakest hero
Doctor Sidhar loses HP from a lost battle only if he lost it by 3 or more
Doctor Sidhar may put a drawn token aside and draw again, 1 HP each time; set-aside tokens go back in the bag
Elspeth may reroll one die in each combat and must keep the new roll
Elspeth can pass through a monster's tile to the tile beyond for 1 move and 1 HP
Kirima can use a move to jump to any tile with a hurt hero and heal them 1 HP (an unconscious hero wakes up)
Kirima gets +1 strength against a monster revealed on an earlier turn
Roll the dice to determine the starting player

modules.name: Regent
modules.note: 4 heroes, new monsters, items and rooms, and the Lord of Karak game version.

modules.name: Sidhar, Kirima, Elspeth
modules.note: 3 more heroes: Doctor Sidhar (Alchemist), Elspeth (Warrior Princess) and Kirima (Beast Hunter). Their abilities are under Easy to forget.
